title: rubia hexaphylla
intro: Rubia hexaphylla, commonly known as Japanese madder, is a plant species belonging to the Rubiaceae family, native to East Asia. The health benefits of Rubia hexaphylla include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of various diseases. Therapeutically, it is used to treat conditions such as fever, diarrhea, and skin infections due to its therapeutic actions of analgesia, anti-inflammation, and antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents of Rubia hexaphylla include anthraquinones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
